findings.finding: No Barnes G implementation or directly relevant PR was found by the listed repository issue-title/body search, current indexed public discussion search, or pinned native source inspection. This is a limited negative search result, not a proof that no private, unindexed or differently named work exists.
findings.decision: Independent target A1.7 on existing Complex.Gamma and analytic carriers; keep new Barnes APIs additive.

findings.finding: No holomorphic determinant-line implementation was found by these specific searches. The determinant-line phrase query returned three unrelated determinant tactic PRs. Pinned Tau Ceti already provides pointwise scalar-generic determinant lines and stabilization; A1.1 must consume those.
findings.decision: Use ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm, FredholmPackage, TauCeti.detLine, LinearMap.detLine, detLineCongr and native stabilization. Own the holomorphic bundle/section comparisons.

findings.finding: Open WIP Fredholm branch uses exploratory IsFredholmStruct/IsFredholmQuot and FredholmDecomposition declarations, and its examined source includes sorry placeholders. It does not supply holomorphic determinant lines.
findings.decision: Do not replace the pinned accepted ContinuousLinearMap.IsFredholm API by WIP names or wait for this branch.

findings.finding: Open WIP properness criterion for upper semi-Fredholm operators; no determinant line or canonical holomorphic section.
findings.decision: No added dependency; existing pinned Fredholm/stabilization carriers suffice for A1.1.

findings.finding: Open operator-norm carrier generalization to semiring modules, motivated by nonarchimedean work. Its scope is not a complex trace-class or holomorphic determinant package.
findings.decision: Maintain standard native bounded-operator carriers and do not clone operator norm; no new dependency.

findings.finding: Open one-sided-inverse compact remainder lemmas IsCompactOperator.sub_id_of_rightInverse and sub_id_of_leftInverse. It is adjacent operator infrastructure, not a determinant-line construction.
findings.decision: No dependency on an unmerged result is required by the current target.

findings.finding: The public topic 'compact operators and Fredholm determinant' distinguishes nonarchimedean needs from classical complex Fredholm/spectral work. Bhavik Mehta reports existing work with Thomas Browning on complex compact operators and Fredholm alternative/spectral results; no Barnes or holomorphic determinant-family construction is supplied by that topic.
findings.decision: Keep the complex and nonarchimedean determinant scopes separate; do not consume the existing nonarchimedean fredholmDet carrier as a complex determinant.
